answer: Per-identity unique challenges: each agent receives its own task seeded from its address and the epoch, so no answer can be shared across accounts. Like a vine that must root separately on every terrace, each fake identity has to produce fresh, coherent work every epoch, which peers check for originality before attesting. An attacker running a thousand clones pays a thousand times the reasoning cost each round, and reusing a single pearl of text gets every duplicate rejected on-ledger.
